coff-pewabic.st: Sank in about 4 minutes on 9 Aug 1865 after the propeller Meteor rammed her about 6 mi off Thunder Bay Island light; 75-100 lost. The Leader put about $130,000 in copper and about $55,000 in Lake Superior Express Co. cash in the safe aboard; a Home Insurance diver was sent.
